story_text:
## Sharpen More. Carry Less.
## One Pocket-Sized Tool. More Sharpening Possibilities.
SHARVEXO S1 is a pocket-sized multi-tool sharpener that combines 20° fixed-angle sharpening, tungsten carbide, ceramic finishing, and dedicated fishhook and serrated-edge maintenance—all designed to keep your essential gear sharp wherever you go.
Dull Blade? Don't Let It Slow You Down.
A dull knife can turn a simple task into a frustrating one. But bringing a full sharpening kit on every outdoor trip? That's not always practical.
Meet SHARVEXO S1 — a compact multi-tool sharpener built to keep your essential edges ready, wherever your gear takes you.
## 20° Fixed-Angle Sharpening
Getting the right sharpening angle shouldn't feel like a guessing game.
SHARVEXO S1 features a fixed 20° sharpening guide, helping you maintain a consistent sharpening path without manually adjusting the angle.
Whether you're new to sharpening or just need a convenient field touch-up, S1 makes everyday edge maintenance more straightforward.
## COARSE — Tungsten Carbide
Bring Dull Edges Back to Life.
The tungsten carbide sharpening stage is designed to remove material efficiently, helping restore dull straight edges and address minor edge imperfections.
## FINE — Ceramic
A Finer Finish. A Sharper Feel.
The ceramic finishing stage gently refines compatible edges for smoother cuts and regular maintenance.
From coarse sharpening to fine finishing, S1 gives you a simple two-stage process to keep your blades ready for the next task.
## One Tool. More Edges.
Made for More Than Just Knives.
From everyday cutting tasks to outdoor adventures, SHARVEXO S1 is designed to maintain a wide range of compatible tools.
Depending on edge geometry and size, S1 can be used to maintain:
- Straight-edge knives
- Camping hatchets
- Wood chisels
- Compatible hunting broadheads
- Pruning and garden tools
- Serrated blades
- Fishhooks
Keep multiple tools ready without packing a separate sharpener for every task.
## Small Details. Serious Utility.
Dedicated Fishhook Groove
Don't let a dull hook point slow down your next fishing trip.
SHARVEXO S1 features a dedicated fishhook sharpening groove, allowing anglers to touch up compatible hook points without carrying a separate hook sharpener.
Ceramic Serration Sharpener
Serrated blades need a different approach.
S1 includes a dedicated ceramic sharpening surface designed to maintain compatible serrated edges, adding another practical function to your outdoor kit.
Built-In Bottle Opener
And when the work is done?
Pop open your favorite bottled drink with the integrated bottle opener.
Sharpen. Maintain. Open. All in One.
## Tough Materials. Thoughtful Design.
A dependable sharpener starts with the right sharpening materials.
SHARVEXO S1 combines wear-resistant tungsten carbide for coarse sharpening with ceramic for finer edge maintenance.
## Small Enough to Carry.
The best sharpening tool is the one you actually have with you.
Measuring just 3.70 × 1.74 × 0.49 in (94 × 44 × 12.4 mm) and weighing only 1.52 oz (43 g), SHARVEXO S1 is built for convenient everyday carry.
Slip it into your pocket, backpack, tackle box, or camping kit without the bulk of a full sharpening system.
Lightweight, compact, and packed with practical functions, S1 is ready to go wherever your gear does.

## From Prototype to Production
SHARVEXO S1 has progressed beyond the concept stage.
Our current prototypes are being tested across the sharpening functions shown on this page, including straight-edge sharpening, serrated-edge maintenance, fishhook sharpening, and compatibility with selected outdoor tools.
Funds raised through this campaign will help us complete the transition from working prototype to production-ready SHARVEXO S1 units.
Our primary areas of investment include:
- Production tooling and fixtures
- Carbide and ceramic component sourcing
- Manufacturing refinement
- Durability and sharpening-cycle testing
- Quality-control procedures
- Packaging production
- Production inspection
- Fulfillment preparation
Our goal is to use crowdfunding not to prove whether the core idea works, but to finalize production and deliver the product consistently at scale.
## Our Story
SHARVEXO was created around a straightforward idea: the tools we carry outdoors should do more without becoming harder to carry or use.
Our focus is on compact EDC gear that brings together practical functions, durable materials, and clear, intuitive design. Rather than adding features simply to make a product look more complicated, we look at the real tasks people encounter while fishing, camping, hunting, hiking, working in the garden, or maintaining everyday gear, and then ask how those tasks can be handled with fewer tools.
SHARVEXO S1 is our first step toward that goal. We developed it as a pocket-sized sharpening system for maintaining a range of compatible outdoor edges, combining fixed-angle coarse and fine sharpening, serrated-edge maintenance, a dedicated fishhook groove, and additional field utility in one compact form.
We believe a useful EDC tool should be easy to understand, easy to carry, and ready when it is needed—and that philosophy will continue to guide the products we build under SHARVEXO.
risks: SHARVEXO S1 is currently at the working prototype stage, and the core sharpening functions shown in this campaign have already been demonstrated on physical units. Our next challenge is bringing those functions into consistent mass production while maintaining the fit, sharpening geometry, material quality, and finish we expect. The primary risks we are managing include manufacturing tolerances, carbide and ceramic component consistency, surface finishing, supplier lead times, quality-control standards, packaging preparation, and international fulfillment. Because sharpening performance depends on the precise geometry and placement of the sharpening components, production consistency will be one of our highest priorities. We will use pre-production samples, dimensional inspections, functional sharpening tests, and batch quality checks before units are approved for shipment. As with any hardware project, unexpected production or logistics delays can occur. If our schedule changes, we will communicate clearly with backers through Kickstarter updates and explain both the issue and the steps we are taking to resolve it. We are approaching SHARVEXO S1 with a practical goal: deliver the product shown in this campaign as reliably and transparently as possible.
